name: vkit
description: Machine-checked evidence for agents: which registered checks are fresh, stale or failing for the code as it is now, and a gate that is READY only when all of them passed.

project_root.title: Project root
project_root.description: The enrolled repository this plugin operates on. Every vkit MCP tool is bound to this one root; no tool accepts a different one.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Interpreter that has vkit installed. The hooks read the gate through it.
